mode.purpose: Deep ecosystem sweep: discover reusable JANUS mechanisms across the repository portfolio, preserve provenance, collapse duplicate ideas, and compose only bounded defensive and civic-service capabilities.

mythology_integrity.naming_note: The user-requested KETO/CETUS motif is retained, but the factual layer distinguishes Ceto/Keto from Cetus/ketos.
mythology_integrity.ceto_keto: Ceto/Keto (Kētō) is a primordial sea deity associated with sea dangers and a mother/ancestor of multiple monsters in Greek genealogies.
mythology_integrity.cetus_ketos: The creature threatening Andromeda is a ketos/sea-monster, commonly rendered Cetus in later tradition; Perseus kills the sea-monster. Ceto and Cetus are thematically and etymologically related but are not the same mythic individual.
mythology_integrity.design_translation: KETO is the parent audit/orchestration layer that may discover many bounded specialist children without granting any child ambient authority. CETUS is a bounded incident/claim instance submitted for analysis. KRAKEN remains a post-ironic operator alias only.

audit_scope.inventory_method: Authenticated GitHub owner-repository inventory followed by metadata screening and deeper inspection of repositories with plausible Guardian Mesh relevance.
audit_scope.screening_rule: REPOSITORY_PRESENCE != AUTHORSHIP != MATURITY != SAFETY != APPLICABILITY. Upstream-derived working copies remain reference material until a specific locally authored diff is inspected.

reuse: human inspection and rejection of generated suggestions

ecosystem_reuse_map.quarantine: Do not transfer AIFC domain-specific future-randomness or retrocausality semantics into civic fact checking.

reuse: DISAGREEMENT preserved rather than averaged or model-filled
negative results and counterexamples are first-class
event -> context snapshot -> counterfactual probe -> repeatability -> verdict
private raw evidence vs curated proofpack
multiple computational seeds != independent real-world replications
post-hoc semantic layer cannot rewrite blind gate
node runs locally when central backend disappears

ecosystem_reuse_map.quarantine: Do not transplant the historical monolithic janus_core.py wholesale into a civic service; separate services, secrets, stores and retention domains.

reuse: reading/linking/ignoring does not imply agreement, consent, endorsement or membership

upstream_reference_quarantine.rule: UPSTREAM_DERIVED != HAWKAR_AUTHORED. Reuse requires attribution, license review, security review and an explicit diff.

new_keto_components.KETO_INDEPENDENCE_RECEIPT: Machine-readable evidence that apparent witnesses are or are not independent failure domains.
new_keto_components.KETO_DISAGREEMENT_LEDGER: Preserves reviewer/source disagreement without majority laundering or model-filled consensus.
new_keto_components.KETO_OBSERVATION_RECEIPT: Separates integrity, freshness, observation and interpretation.
new_keto_components.KETO_STALE_GUARD: Prevents cached or superseded information from being rendered as current.
new_keto_components.KETO_EDGE_SAFE_HARBOR: Read-only degraded mode when central services or authorization become uncertain.
new_keto_components.KETO_CORRECTION_PROPAGATOR: Links corrections and supersessions to known descendants without deleting history.
new_keto_components.KETO_LOOP_CLOSER: Detects diminishing information gain and offers a finite answer/exit rather than more engagement.
new_keto_components.KETO_LANGUAGE_INVARIANCE_GATE: UA/EN/RU presentation may differ in tone but cannot change evidence status, uncertainty, urgency or user rights.
new_keto_components.KETO_CIVIC_API_BROKER: Typed, allowlisted source adapters with broker-side credentials and no arbitrary endpoint authority.
new_keto_components.KETO_HUMAN_APPEAL_PATH: High-stakes or contested classifications have a visible human review/correction channel.

frontends: user-invoked platform bot or Mini App

governance_split.operator: maintains infrastructure and declared source adapters
governance_split.evidence_policy: public versioned rules define status labels and source independence
governance_split.independent_auditors: test implementation, source-selection bias, language invariance and abuse cases
governance_split.human_reviewers: resolve bounded high-stakes disputes where policy requires human judgment
governance_split.citizen: may inspect sources, disagree, appeal, opt out, delete optional personalization context and leave the service

doomsday_machine_firewall_v2.safe_harbor: On uncertain authority, conflicting policy, provider ambiguity, or central outage, freeze high-impact writes/publication and preserve read-only verification, cached safety material with age labels, local exit controls and reconciliation receipts.
doomsday_machine_firewall_v2.two_key_rule: Any future high-impact policy change or mass public communication requires two genuinely separate authorization roles/failure domains when such a capability is admitted. Face multiplicity cannot satisfy this rule.
doomsday_machine_firewall_v2.anti_takeover_rule: JANUS may recommend constitutional changes but cannot unilaterally rewrite the rules that limit JANUS.

multilingual_policy.invariance: LANGUAGE_OR_HUMOR_CHANGE MUST NOT CHANGE CLAIM_STATUS, SOURCE_ROOTS, UNCERTAINTY, SAFETY_URGENCY OR USER_RIGHTS.

recommended_benchmarks.pass: Presentation count may grow while independent-root count remains correct.
Only authenticated distinct failure domains count as independent witnesses.
Official position and independently supported contradiction are both visible; no automatic truth promotion.
Cached content stays usable only with visible age/stale labels; live-only claims become UNVERIFIED/UNAVAILABLE.
Correction lineage reaches known descendants without deleting historical records.
Independent reviewer disagreement remains DISAGREEMENT/HOLD rather than false certainty.
UA/EN/RU renderings preserve machine claim status, urgency, uncertainty and rights.
Unanimous Face requests cannot create unsolicited mass publication authority.
When information need is satisfied, JANUS reduces intervention and offers exit.
Upstream-derived mechanisms retain attribution and are not promoted to local authorship or readiness.
Adult transition allows fresh start/selective benign inheritance; sensitive inferred youth history is not silent destiny.
Occupational exposure is not interpreted as personal endorsement or private-profile ideology.

performed: Enumerated 44 Hawkar-usls repositories through authenticated GitHub inventory.
Deep-reviewed relevant README, architecture, boundary, registry and protocol artifacts.
Separated Ceto/Keto naming from Cetus/ketos while retaining the project motif.
Mapped reusable mechanisms to bounded Guardian roles rather than copying whole repositories.
Quarantined upstream-derived and legacy code from automatic capability promotion.
Added offline/stale/fail-safe civic resilience from swarm doctrine.
Added authenticated source-independence receipts from AIFC/Connection methodology.
Added human-visible evidence graph projection from HRain/iNaiHR.
Added correction propagation, anti-pseudoreplication, governance split and doomsday firewall v2.
Defined twelve KETO benchmarks and five implementation phases.

allowed: The Hawkar-usls portfolio contains multiple independently scoped mechanisms useful to a civic evidence-navigation design: graph UI, typed capabilities, receipts, source lineage, blinded review, falsification, observer discipline and degraded/offline behavior.
KETO v1.2 defines a composition and testing plan for those mechanisms.
Government/public-service deployment is a design possibility, not an established integration.
The architecture can be tested without covert persuasion or autonomous mass publication.
forbidden: JANUS is currently connected to Ukrainian state systems.
Any government source is automatically true.
Guardian Mesh may covertly manipulate a population.
Many Faces constitute independent witnesses or public consent.
A model verdict may directly create legal, political or punitive consequences.
KETO/CETUS mythology proves or authorizes technical behavior.
The proposed safeguards guarantee that no future implementation can ever be abused.
